scope: Extracted real C++ methods with controlled worker threads and API stubs. Sampler/RMS operation latency and Win32 working-set behavior; not model tokens/s or whole image-generation gains.
timing_controls: Three balanced ABBA/BAAB repeats, fixed per-fixture CPU affinity (physical cores first, then siblings); background audit and compilers finished. Runtime affinity/settings untouched.

compiler_scopes.sampler: Production llama.o baseline x64 ISA, Haswell tuning, O3 and LTO4; no -march=haswell or __AVX2__ gate.
compiler_scopes.cpu_rms: Production compute-object Haswell/AVX2 ISA, O3 and LTO4; original double accumulation.

sampler_fixture: Minimal chain with one greedy child, without temperature/top-k/grammar filters. Cases describe incoming candidate arrays and do not simulate a complete request chain.

windows_mmap_cpp.scope: actual patched C++ method, Win32 file mapping

windows_mmap_sha256_control.scope: Win32 mapped-file working set; no inference speed claim

greedy_avx2_gated.reason: Initial fixture enabled AVX2 while production llama.o did not; code gate was inactive in the first candidate. Corrected to x64 and remeasured with the production ISA.

single_candidate_diagnostic.reason: The first enabled x64 candidate added about6ns to the one-candidate fixture. Restored the stock no-read early return for size0/1 before final acceptance.

cpu_rms_background_unpinned.reason: Initial background-audit/unpinned trial retained, including noisy full-worker slow samples; acceptance uses the controlled repeats.
